ApiErrors.title: Couldn't complete that
ApiErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was lost — try again.
ApiErrors.invalid: Some of what you entered can't be accepted. Check the details and try again.
ApiErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that here. Ask a workspace admin.
ApiErrors.notFound: That record is no longer available.
ApiErrors.conflict: Someone else changed this just now. Reload and try again.
ApiErrors.dealLineValueConsentRequired: Review the new deal value and confirm it before saving. Your line is still here.
ApiErrors.dealLineValueConsentStale: The deal changed while you were reviewing it. Your line is still here. Save the line again to review the latest value.
ApiErrors.tooManyRequests: That's a lot of requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
ApiErrors.offline: We couldn't reach Connex. Check your connection and try again.
ApiErrors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was lost — try again in a moment.
ApiErrors.sessionExpired: You've been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
ApiErrors.identityCollisionReportTimeout: That report is taking longer than expected. Try again in a moment.
ApiErrors.sharePrivacyHold: This contact asked not to be shared outside this workspace, so new shares are blocked.
ApiErrors.workspaceUnavailable: This belongs to a workspace that is no longer available to you, so nothing was saved. Everything you entered is still here. Copy what you want to keep before you reload.
ApiErrors.workspaceUnavailableNamed: This belongs to {workspace}, which is no longer available to you, so nothing was saved. Everything you entered is still here. Copy what you want to keep before you reload.
ApiErrors.staleRecord: This record has changed since you loaded it. Your changes were not saved. Review the latest version before saving again.
ApiErrors.workspaceLastOwner: This change would leave the workspace without an owner, so nothing changed. Have another member accept workspace ownership before you leave or change the last owner's role.
ApiErrors.organizationLastOwner: This change would leave the organization without an owner, so nothing changed. Have another eligible member accept organization ownership before you leave or change the last owner's role.
ApiErrors.workspaceRecoveryOwnerRequired: The workspace must keep an owner who can manage members and roles, so nothing changed. Ask a current owner to assign the built-in Owner role to an owner before making this change.
ApiErrors.inviteEmailDomainNotAllowed: This invitation was refused because the email domain isn't approved. Use an approved work email, or ask the inviter to have an organization admin check organization allowed domains and a workspace admin check workspace allowed domains in Settings.
ApiErrors.lastPasskeyRequired: This passkey wasn't removed because accounts with administrative access must keep at least one passkey. Add another passkey in Account security before removing this one.
ApiErrors.lastSufficientPasskeyRequired: This passkey wasn't removed because it is your last passkey approved everywhere you have administrative access. Add another passkey and have it approved in each organization before removing this one. Ask another workspace owner or an organization owner for a passkey approval code.
ApiErrors.organizationMemberEligibilityRequired: Organization access wasn't granted. The person must first join a workspace in this organization and verify their email when required. Ask a workspace admin to invite them, then ask an organization owner to grant organization access.
ApiErrors.disclosureIdentityVerificationRequired: The disclosure wasn't prepared because identity verification hasn't been recorded. Ask an organization admin to verify the requester and record verification on the data request before downloading the disclosure.
ApiErrors.approvalPolicyCurrencyInvalid: Document approval could not be checked because an approval policy has an invalid currency. Nothing was changed. Ask a workspace administrator to correct it in Settings → CRM configuration → Approval policies.

ErrorState.title: Something went wrong
ErrorState.body: We couldn't load this page. The issue is usually temporary.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find that
NotFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it was moved or deleted.

site.body: This page doesn't exist. Check the address, or head back to the start.

records.body: This record doesn't exist, or it was deleted. It may also belong to a different workspace.

activity.body: This item doesn't exist, or it was deleted. It may also belong to a different workspace.

library.body: This document or file doesn't exist, or it was deleted.

reports.body: This report doesn't exist, or it was deleted.

AccessDenied.title: You don't have access
AccessDenied.body: You may be in the wrong workspace, or your role doesn't include permission to view this. Try switching workspace, signing in again, or asking a workspace admin.

PermissionsUnavailable.title: We couldn't confirm your permissions
PermissionsUnavailable.body: This page stays hidden until we can check what you're allowed to see. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.
PermissionsUnavailable.sectionBody: This section stays hidden until we can check what you're allowed to see. The issue is usually temporary.

WorkspaceUnavailable.title: We couldn't check your workspaces
WorkspaceUnavailable.body: Your workspace access couldn't be confirmed. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.

CapabilityUnavailable.title: We couldn't check feature availability
CapabilityUnavailable.body: Feature availability couldn't be confirmed. The issue is usually temporary — try again in a moment.

SectionUnavailable.title: Couldn't load this
SectionUnavailable.body: This section couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
